title: Elections Authorities Ban Dharnas, Protests In Leh, Kargil Ahead Of Polls

ai.summary: Elections authorities in Ladakh banned political protests and dharnas ahead of local polls to ensure peaceful election conduct, citing the Model Code of Conduct.

facts.claim: Elections authorities in Ladakh banned political protests and dharnas ahead of local polls to ensure peaceful election conduct
facts.quote: Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Ladakh on Wednesday prohibited political dharnas, protests, rallies and similar collective activities that are likely “to impact the peaceful conduct of elections” within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil during the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) for the upcoming local polls
